front.intro: Behind this East End bungalow, a covered patio stretches beside a large covered garage in a fenced yard. The driveway is new, and so is the fence. Inside, the wiring, plumbing and roof are all new, along with the kitchen and both baths. The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before any of it went in. The Breakfast Nook opens to the rear deck. A new walk leads to the covered front stoop. A Craftsman-style front door opens off the covered porch.

photoA.text: A long covered patio runs along the back of the house, open to the yard on one side. Deck steps lead down from the Breakfast Nook's rear door. There is room for a grill, a long table and a seating group. The yard around it is fenced.

claim.small: An East End bungalow with three-phase power. The roof and the siding are new. The yard is fenced. The baths and the kitchen are all new. The front gable has board and batten siding.
claim.head: What is new

floors.text: You step from the front door into the Living Room, which opens to the Kitchen and the Dining area. The Breakfast Nook sits beside the Kitchen, with a door to the rear deck. The Primary Bedroom is at the back, with a vaulted ceiling and its own bath. Two more bedrooms use the hall bath. The covered patio and the garage sit out back, past the deck steps.
Tall windows and a tray ceiling set the tone in the family room, and the dining area is beside it. The primary bath has a tub for soaking and a separate shower.

top.title: From the Front Door to the Kitchen
top.head: The front rooms
top.sub: One line of sight from the door to the kitchen
top.lede: Come through the front door and you are standing in the Living Room. From there, a cased opening leads to the Dining area, and the Kitchen peninsula is a few steps beyond. The hall to the bedrooms starts at the Dining area, so the bedrooms stay out of the way of the front rooms. Everything on this side of the house is new, from the floors to the lighting.
top.quote: Floors flow from room to room with no thresholds in between.
top.close: The Kitchen is an L with a peninsula, and the peninsula doubles as the breakfast bar. Two pendants light the bar. The peninsula separates the Kitchen from the Dining area. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook are around the corner from the range. The sink sits along the long run of the L, with the dishwasher a step off. The Nook seats a round table, with space to circle it. Counters run the full length of the L. Marble-look tile rises behind the range, up to the hood.

items.name: Living Room
items.text: The front door opens straight into this room from the stoop. A clerestory window high on the wall adds light and keeps privacy. A cased opening joins it to the Dining area and the Kitchen. New floors, trim and lighting carry through.

items.name: Kitchen
items.text: All new, in an L with navy lower cabinets and white shaker uppers. A stainless range sits under a chimney hood, with the dishwasher alongside. The pantry is a step away.

items.name: Dining Area
items.text: From the Dining area, the front door and Living Room are on one side and the Kitchen peninsula is on the other. The hall to the bedrooms starts here. Wood-look floors run through without a threshold. A sputnik-style light hangs over the table.

items.name: Breakfast Nook
items.text: Windows fill two walls of the nook, beside the Kitchen. A round table fits in the middle, with room to walk around it. A door from the nook opens to the backyard. The marble-look backsplash wraps around the corner.

items.name: Breakfast Bar
items.text: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula, with room for barstools. The Dining area sits between the peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. Marble-look counters run its full length, with a serving side and a prep side. The floors are wood-look.

items.name: Range and Sink
items.text: Everything on this wall is new, with a stainless range under a vent hood. The sink and dishwasher sit a step apart. White shaker uppers reach up to the ceiling. Navy cabinets run underneath. The pantry and the Nook are around the corner.

bottom.kicker: The back half of the house
bottom.title: Bedrooms, Baths and Built-Ins
bottom.head: The bedroom wing
bottom.sub: Quiet rooms down the hall from the kitchen
bottom.lede: The Primary Bedroom sits at the back of the house, well away from the street and the front rooms. Bedrooms 2 and 3 open off the hall near the front, and they share the hall bath. Every bedroom has a closet, and the Primary has a shelving tower that gives hanging room on each side. The bath and the walk-in shower are all new. New carpet runs wall to wall in the bedrooms.
bottom.quote: A wing of bedrooms that stays quiet, set back from the street.
bottom.close: The hall bath is a few steps from both secondary bedrooms. The larger of the two sits at the front corner, with windows on two walls. The other has a hall-side closet so the window wall stays clear for a desk. Tile climbs the walls in every bath. The Primary Bath has a niche for shampoo and soap, a rain showerhead and a handheld. The vanity is navy, with drawers and a marble-look top. Interior laundry sits on the same floor. Each bath is all new, from the tile to the lighting.

items.name: Primary Bedroom
items.text: Set at the back of the home, away from the street. The vaulted ceiling carries an exposed painted beam. Windows on two walls bring in light. It fits a king bed and a long dresser.

items.name: Primary Bath
items.text: Double sinks sit on a navy vanity with drawers. A wide LED mirror lights the wall above. Two people can get ready at once. The walk-in shower is just beyond, behind a glass door.

items.name: Hall Bath
items.text: Bedrooms 2 and 3 share this bath, a few steps down the hall. A tub sits under full-height marble-look tile. A pebble tile niche holds soap and shampoo. Everything in the room is new.

items.name: Primary Closet
items.text: Double doors open to a shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides. A shelf follows the back wall. The built-ins stay with the house. The closet opens off the Primary Bedroom.

items.name: Bedroom 2
items.text: The larger secondary bedroom sits at the front corner of the house. Two walls of windows let the light in. It shares the hall bath with Bedroom 3. The closet has double doors.

items.name: Bedroom 3
items.text: The closet sits on the hall side, which leaves the window wall open for a desk. The hall bath is a few steps away. New carpet runs underfoot. It sits between Bedroom 2 and the Primary.
